# Grant Access

Issues time-bound production access and records why it was needed.

## Requesting

Every grant needs a ticket, an expiry, and a named approver from the
owning team. The approver list comes from the service catalog.

## Reviewing

Every quarter, reconcile active grants against tickets. Anything without a
live ticket is revoked the same day. The reconciliation query is in [the
access review notes](docs/access-review.md), and the escalation path in
[the escalation guide](docs/escalation.md).
